subject: Request: HSM log sampling + KEK rotation playbook for SIG review
messages:
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmecorp.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: security@acmecorp.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG: Request for HSM log sampling + KEK rotation playbook

Hi Jonas,

Acme's SIG assessment team is conducting a deep-dive on key lifecycle controls this quarter. For the next round we need the following artifacts from Redwood for the tenant we've been discussing: 1) sample HSM operation logs (wrap/unwrap, key creation, import/export markers) covering the last 90 days, 2) the Key Encryption Key (KEK) rotation playbook that describes cadence, dual-control ceremony, and emergency rotation steps, and 3) the latest HSM attestation/certificate for the cluster that handles BYOK wrapping.

Please let us know the scope of data you can provide (redacted where appropriate) and any timelines—our SIG window closes two weeks from today. We may need short explanatory notes for reviewers (1–2 pages) that describe how logs are sampled and how rotation events are authorized.

Thanks,
Jane
Jane Doe
Lead GRC Analyst, Acme Corp
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: irene_choi@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SIG: Request for HSM log sampling + KEK rotation playbook

Team — forwarding Acme's ask. Deadline is tight (two weeks). Can we break this up:
- Irene: pull HSM wrap/unwrap and KEK rotation logs (last 90 days), include event IDs and timestamps. Provide a CSV export and a zipped sample set.
- Laura: produce the playbook doc (1–2 pages executive + appendices with step-by-step checks) and the narrative for reviewers describing sampling methodology and redaction approach.
- Marissa: collect the attestation certificate and confirm it matches our hosted HSM cluster identifiers; prepare the notarized statement for the tenant.

Security notes: minimize PII in samples—use redaction index + SHA256 hashes for original files. We'll attach redaction index and hashes so Acme can verify integrity without seeing raw sensitive data. Also confirm whether Acme needs DocuSign attestation.

Deadline for first drafts: EOD Tuesday (2027-06-29). I'll coordinate the final package.

Jonas Weber
Head of Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG: Request for HSM log sampling + KEK rotation playbook

Jonas — starting the exports. Quick tech notes for the playbook team so outputs match checks:
- Log query: cluster=hsm-prod-2 AND (event IN (WRAP, UNWRAP, KEY_CREATE, KEY_IMPORT, KEY_EXPORT)) AND timestamp >= 2027-03-28.
- We'll produce two artefacts: (A) a redacted CSV sample (columns: event_id, event_type, timestamp, operator_id_redacted, key_id_hash), and (B) a zipped package with original log files hashed (SHA256) + a text file mapping redaction rules.
- For KEK rotation: we'll include the rotation schedule (90-day cadence by default), the rotation approval workflow (dual-approver with rotation ticket), and emergency rotation checklist (key revocation and re-wrap steps).

Note: HSM vendor policy disallows exporting private key material; exports will show wrap/unwrap tokens and key IDs only. We'll include a brief note in the narrative explaining vendor export limits and how we demonstrate continuity of control (hashes + attestation cert).

Irene Choi
Senior Security Engineer
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG: Request for HSM log sampling + KEK rotation playbook

Quick follow-up on acceptance criteria from Acme: do they need logs in a specific format (CSV vs JSON) and will they accept redacted samples plus hashes, or do they want live console access for a short view? I recommend: CSV export + zipped originals (hashed) + 2-page narrative.

I've drafted the playbook (attached as rotation-playbook-2027-06.docx) which covers:
- Purpose & scope (tenant isolation, BYOK handling)
- Roles & responsibilities (operator, approver, auditor)
- Standard rotation procedure (pre-checks, ticketing, dual-authorization, wrap/until-verify)
- Emergency rotation (revoke/re-wrap, client notice, rollback plan)
- Evidence checklist (logs, cert, hashes)

If Acme requires DocuSign for attestation we should surface a short statement for the CISO to sign. Marissa — can you pull the attestation cert and confirm the covered serials?

Laura Bennett
Security Compliance Manager
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Acme Corp GRC Team <grc@acmecorp.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: Request for HSM log sampling + KEK rotation playbook — evidence package delivered (preview)

Jane — attaching the preview evidence package for your SIG reviewers. Per Acme's window, we prioritized redacted exports and provenance checks rather than raw key material. Attachments included:
- hsm_rotation_snapshot_202704-202706.csv (redacted sample of wrap/unwrap + rotation events)
- kek_wrap_unwrap_log_samples.zip (original logs hashed; redaction index included)
- hsm_attestation_certificate_2026-11.pdf (vendor attestation matching cluster IDs)
- redaction_index_and_hashes.txt (SHA256 list for zipped originals)
- rotation-playbook-2027-06.docx (playbook + emergency checklist)

Summary of key points for reviewers:
- Rotation cadence: default 90 days for KEKs; emergency rotation procedure documented and tested during last tabletop in 2027-Q1.
- Authorization: rotations require two approvers (operator + approver) logged in ticketing system; approvals are time-stamped and retained in our audit logs.
- Proof of continuity: original log files are hashed and provided alongside redacted samples so Acme can verify integrity without receiving private key material.

If you have a preferred format or need DocuSign for a signed attestation, flag it and we'll expedite. Happy to hop on a quick 30-min call with the review team to walk through artifacts.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: rotation-playbook-2027-06.docx; hsm_rotation_snapshot_202704-202706.csv; kek_wrap_unwrap_log_samples.zip; hsm_attestation_certificate_2026-11.pdf; redaction_index_and_hashes.txt
